explicit_noncount_cases.label: Ring
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Ch 20, check the relaxed ring against the stand, then sl st to first ch without twisting
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: 20-chain foundation ring, or explicitly allowed 24-chain alternative; R1 is into ring not chains

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Spoke
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Join CC through the fabric immediately outside the centre ring; work relaxed surface sl sts outward along one pinned guide to its marked increase column; FO at the outer edge
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: Variable number of surface slip stitches; no growth stitches added

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Repeat
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Repeat the complete join-to-FO spoke route separately at each remaining marked column

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Border
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Join CC in any st; ch 1, [sc in next st, skip 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts] around, sl st to first sc, FO
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: Border independently checked at all three stop sizes; does not consume a joining extra anchor

explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Ch 12, sl st to first ch to form a ring; place marker
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: 12-chain closed foundation, no turning chain counted

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Join
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: FO with a 40 cm tail; keep openings round, align the 12 final-round sts with the 12 foundation ch, and whip-stitch 12 pairs around
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: 12 matched seam pairs; final 3 pairs closed after stuffing

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Hanger
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: After joining the ring, wrap a load-rated woven cord or ribbon TWICE around the entire tube at the top; tie and secure it according to the cord/ribbon maker’s instructions, with the knot at the back
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: External hanger; not a crochet round, no load rating inferred

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Petals
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Join red with a sl st in any centre sc; (ch 4, 3 tr, ch 4, sl st) in that same centre stitch; [sl st in next centre sc, (ch 4, 3 tr, ch 4, sl st) in that same stitch] x 5; FO
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: Six separately anchored petals; tall stitches and chains checked; positioning and end sl sts are not new centre anchors

explicit_noncount_cases.label: Tie
explicit_noncount_cases.instruction: Attach one folded 55 cm green tie under at least 2 sturdy back sts as in technique 4
explicit_noncount_cases.reason: Removable folded tie, anchored under at least two back stitches; no round count
